description: This Java class 'FileUtils' provides utility methods for reading from and writing to files, specifically for processing engine state data and saving a list of doubles to a file.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: Utility class for file reading and writing operations related to engine states and data lists.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file line by line, encoding each line, and passing the data to an engine state listener.

methods.name: readFile2
methods.description: Reads a specified file, processes each line into a packed string, and feeds it into the engine state.

methods.name: saveList
methods.description: Saves a list of Double values into a specified file, each value on a new line.
